Get comfortable wherever you are. You don't need to do anything special. Just arrive here for a few minutes.

Now we'll move attention slowly through the body. Wherever it lands, simply notice what's there.
Bring your attention to your feet and toes. Notice warmth or coolness, pressure, tingling, or nothing at all.
